annotations.title: How a live race is going

description: Shows how a live race on livedot is going. Use it when the user asks how a race is going or who is leading ("How's the Comrades going?", "Who's leading the Coast Classic?"). Inputs: event (the race's name). Returns: whether it's live, how long it has been under way, how many people are on the public map, how many have finished, and the leaders the public race map shows, with a live map. If several races match, it lists them so the user can choose. Limits: public races only; only what the public race map shows. Read-only.

club.description: A club or team, if the user asked about one in this race (as club_in_race).

coach.description: A coach, if the user asked about their athletes in this race (as club_in_race).

event.description: The race's name, e.g. "Comrades", "Coast Classic demo".

units.description: Pass the asker's units: imperial for users in the US, UK road distances, Liberia or Myanmar, or when they ask in miles/°F; otherwise metric.

name: event_status

outputSchema.description: How a live race is going.

can_tap_team.description: A team tap would reach at least one of them now.

club.description: The club: name, app (windline or runfast), slug, url (its page).

clubs.description: Several clubs matched: name, app, people. Ask which one.

count.description: How many of the club's people are on its live map in that race.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

finished_count.description: How many of them have finished.

leaders.description: The leaders the public race map shows: name, and finished (time) or km and where (null km near the start or finish).

members.description: Each member on the club's live map (Findable): id (for where_is), name, photo, status, sub (km and goal delta, or the finish time), km (null near the start or finish), goal_delta, can_tap.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

on_course.description: How many are on the course.

on_map.description: How many people are on livedot's map.

race.description: The race (or ride) its members are in.

races.description: Several races matched: name, app, people. Ask which one.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

upcoming.description: Not live yet: upcoming races with name, start, url.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: How a live race is going
